content.short: Noves is the data access stack for blockchains and their ecosystem.
content.description: On-chain data in its raw form can be hard to access, read, and use. Noves provides ready-to-use data tools and integrations that simplify pulling, interpreting, and working with data across your entire blockchain ecosystem. Integrations include Blockscout, MetaMask Snap, a Chrome extension, and Wallet History Export. With coverage across 45+ chains and more than 500 million smart contracts, Noves delivers a cohesive, enhanced data experience for users everywhere.
